profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: In my role, I leverage my expertise in software engineering to design, develop, and implement innovative solutions that utilize LLMs to enhance the shopping experience for users. I'm passionate about the potential of LLMs to personalize search results, provide more relevant product recommendations, and ultimately make shopping on Google more efficient and enjoyable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · Machine Learning · C++

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: I work with a team of optics experts to combine new theoretical science with cheap modern hardware for competitive medical products.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description: I respond directly to the CFO of the company and have a wide array of responsibilities. I handle all the things that one would expect from an IT Manager such as network management, IT assistance, and disaster recovery. On top of these things,  given my background in computer science and business,  go above and beyond by also managing our SQL database, data representation, and data analytics. My most recent flagship project is a website written in PHP, SQL and JavaScript where all manufacturing jobs are clearly listed along with every single step they require and how long each of those steps would take based off of historical data. This tool is valuable for the manufacturing plant because they can easily see where the bottlenecks are in the plant and could have a very accurate visual on how long  jobs would take to make.

positions.title: C++ Specialist
positions.description: Due to a research endevor, a pivotal peice of code that was written in matlab needed to run as fast as possible. In matlab it took two days to run. My job was to re write it in C++ and make sure it ran as fast as possible using parallellism. Besides the matlab code being tens of thousands of lines long coupled with it being uncommented,  the main challenge was converting the series of matrix mathemetical inputs into functional programming.  The c++ code i ended up making ran in a couple of hours. I mostly worked on the project during my summers.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: IAHD is a government founded program that provides day care to those with Intellectual Disabilities. I also returned to work here for the following summer. I specifically worked in the offices where HR, accounting, and management reside. Here I handled technological issues in a professional environment, learned multiple IT skills including trouble shooting for computers and other electronic devices, and took part in database creation that would be used by IAHD workers.

positions.title: Technical Assistant III
positions.description: Assisted the IT department at the Bio Statistic Center Research Facilities. Here I was delegated the task to managed project to design an Apple app for a government sponsored program providing doctors with insight into the latest research and medical procedures for HIV/AIDS. Also I had extensive experience in both databases and media conversion thanks to this experience.

projects.title: The Disputed Federalist Papers
projects.description: A course project for CSC240- Data Mining. This project attempted to find the authorship of 10 papers who have been disputed to be either Hamilton or Madison by scholars. Using the K nearest neighbors algorithm and a data set consisting of the number of times 80 words were repeated in a tune and train set of 100 papers where we know the authorship, we found the likely authorship of the 10 disputed papers.  This was an elegant and powerful project.

projects.title: Housewives vs Zombies
projects.description:
This is the final project I made for a game design class in high school consisting of two highly motivated individuals .It is  A single player local game that features housewives from the 50's taking matters into their own hands as they defend a hospital from an onslaught of male zombies in order to give time for the last surviving female scientist to make a vaccine.  The idea is that this specific zombie apocalypse only affected males. 

I had large ambitions going in, and my main focus was to make it fun. I was surprised at the amount of fun I had creating the game, where I made decisive decisions in all aspects. I made everything from the sounds to the art- using a collage-like artistic style from google images. After creating the engine and the zombie AI, I fiddled with the numeric parameters for hours until the game was playable. It was an intense experience that made me realize my passion for game design.
